mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot, '$.baseKey')) = #{base} AND result_entity_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT result_entity_id AS report_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot, '$.idempotencyKey')) = #{key} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task( record_type, task_domain, task_key, task_status, input_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until, result_entity_type ) VALUES( 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY', 'REPORT', CONCAT('REPORT_KEY:', SHA2(#{row.key}, 256)), 'PENDING', JSON_OBJECT('idempotencyKey', #{row.key}, 'generationSource', #{row.source}, 'baseKey', #{row.baseKey}, 'regenerationNo', #{row.regeneration}), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 365 DAY), 'AI_REPORT' )
mapper.select: SELECT result_entity_id AS report_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY' AND task_key = CONCAT('REPORT_KEY:', SHA2(#{key}, 256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot, '$.regenerationNo')) AS UNSIGNED) FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot, '$.baseKey')) = #{base} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', result_entity_id = #{report}, output_snapshot = JSON_OBJECT('reportId', #{report}), completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_IDEMPOTENCY' AND task_key = CONCAT('REPORT_KEY:', SHA2(#{key}, 256))
